segments.text: An angel who lives in the town's church, and whose powers are inferior to other angels'. Aine is always cheerful and kind, though also a little clumsy. She is the vocalist and guitarist of the angel-made band "CaS". Her motto in life is "My happiness is to make other people happy." For some reason, her favorite food is bananas.

Tomoe's childhood friend and classmate. She is naturally cheerful and kind, and is often thought to be Tomoe's girlfriend. However, at the same time she is like the typical childhood friend character: she always comes to wake Tomoe up through his window, and makes sure that he eats breakfast.

Tomoe's upperclassman who lives in a faculty with her little sister due to having lost her parents at a young age. Her daily routine consist of her going to pick up her sister from another school. Yuri doesn't have many friends due to thinking many things are better done alone than in a group.
Aine's classmate who is often absent from school and has a weak presence.
She is actually an entertainer who spends most of her time working, but she keeps this a secret from the school. In the past, her mother was a singer, and Minamo was influenced by her.
One of the members of the angel-made band "CaS". She plays the keyboard. Erik is strong-willed and always worried about Aine, though she can be fussy at times too.
One of the members of the angel-made band "CaS". She plays the drums. A hedonistic and kind girl who likes Tomoe very much, and also likes to tease him with her body.
One of the members of the angel-made band "CaS". She plays the bass. Rika is very quiet and stoic all the time, and nobody knows what she's thinking. Has the ability to heal any wounds.
An unusual angel with black wings. He is knowledgeable of things that many angels don't know.
Another angel with black wings, she follows Raios everywhere.
Yuri's younger sister who is quite selfish but very protective of her older sister.
Tomoe's classmate and self-proclaimed friend who is an honor student.
A princess-like girl who is called the school's Madonna.

The student council president of Tomoe's school. He is a complete honor student and very serious about keeping up the peace in school; in fact, Tomoe and the people around him are his greatest enemies.
Tomoe's homeroom teacher who also teaches English. She is popular within the academy due to her height and baby face, and her students have nicknamed her "Yume-chan-sensei".

A second-year student who is very shy and introverted. Fumiko doesn't have many friends due to her bad communication skills and she finds it hard to talk even with those few friends she does have. She also doesn't have any hobbies aside from surfing around the internet.

A second-year student and one of Fumiko's few friends who is very social. She is the complete opposite of Fumiko considering personality, looks and hobbies: she loves talking especially about romance and sweet things.
A first-year student who is the student council's secretary. He is very petite and cute, and idolizes Masahiko very much, to the point of always helping him out no matter what the request.

A second-year student who is very serious about her studies. Because of the struggle her parents had when Marika was younger, she hopes to have a perfect future by finding a job at a good company. She often corrects others and is blunt in general.
A painter. He has been trying to meet the expectations of his parents who are also painters, but otherwise for that, he lives his life freely.

As one could already guess from his appearance, the third-year student Osamu is a kind man both to animals and people. Due to this, he often has to take care of such things as the class president's job and watering the flowerbeds.
A second-year student who is a member of the basketball club. He is well-liked and has a simple personality. He is also classmate with Fumiko.
The leader of an indie band which has been gaining major popularity recently. Haruki is secretly dating Yuno, and by secretly he means that he keeps it a secret from his crazy fans.
A second-year student who is a member of the sports club. He is somewhat of a my-pace guy and is always wearing a jersey. He was in the same class with Tomoe last year.

The school nurse of Tomoe's school. Though he is a relaxed person, there are often rumors of him flying around about him being a womanizer and "getting fresh with female students visiting the infirmary".
Naruko's father who teaches archery. He is a very kind man and he trusts his students very much.
An anti-social and apathetic young man. With the exception of Naruko, he has few people that could be considered friends. His one hobby is archery, an activity he can perform alone.
